entries.70ded6367c2dd1ca: It sets forth its long-term vision "Grand Vision 2030" looking ahead to fiscal 2030, and aims to become an environmental leading company needed by society. Under its medium-term management plan, it states that it will supply products and make resource-recycling proposals to industries where medium- to long-term growth is expected, and advance business growth and expansion of results. In order to respond to growing demand for recycling of used chemicals in electronics fields such as semiconductors, batteries and electronic components, it aims to start operation in fiscal 2027 of a subsidiary's resource-recycling plant in Kitakyushu City, and states that it will also respond to domestic resource circulation of precious metals, rare metals and other materials.
